method: Normalized Hebrew contiguous-token alignment; exact anchors require runs of at least two tokens, with monotonic interpolation between anchors.

qualityOverride.basis: 188 exact contiguous-token anchors span six of seven canonical transcript segments. Beginning and ending dialogue contexts were inspected. Segment 117-a-003 is an extended bracketed song sequence; Hebrew speech ASR established no safe contiguous anchors there, so that segment remains ordinary non-seekable transcript text. Only exact words in the six anchored segments are seekable; interpolated words remain visibly distinguished.
